paragraph: We took plenty of photos to **capture** the moment. It takes a good trap to **capture** a bear. They would **capture** as many people as possible.
english: act of capturing

paragraph: The king **abused** his power. Child **abuse**, no matter who does it, is wrong. We can only **abuse** of things that are good.
english: improper treatment or usage
arabicDesc: مثال: أساء الملك استخدام سلطته.

paragraph: We talk on the phone on a regular **basis**. We'll take it on a case-by-case **basis**. Life continues to surprise me on a daily **basis**.
english: a physical base or foundation
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: أساس

paragraph: What kinds of **Japanese** food do you like? I'm going to a **Japanese** restaurant by car. What do you think about the **Japanese** language?
english: of or relating to Japan
arabicDesc: مثال: ما نوع الأكلات اليابانية التي تحبها؟

other.meaning: A citizen or national of Japan (incl. Ryukyuans and Ainu people) (noun)
A language that is primarily spoken in East Asia and is the official language of Japan (noun)

paragraph: Nobody argued against choosing him as **chairman**. The **chairman** suggested that we should discuss the problem. The **chairman** is elected for a two year term.
english: person presiding over a meeting
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يعارض أحد انتخابه كرئيس للمجلس.

paragraph: Where did you get the **pattern** for your new dress? Color and **pattern** matter more than brand names. He thought that he saw a **pattern**.
english: that from which a copy is made
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: نموذج، عينة

paragraph: I work here, I'm not a **guest**. I can stay in the **guest** room. The **guest** whom we were waiting for had come.
english: recipient of hospitality
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا أعمل هنا. لست زائرا.

paragraph: Young men and women fought to **defend** their country. We need to teach children how to **defend** themselves. We have to **defend** our country at any cost.
english: to ward off attacks against
arabicDesc: مثال: رجال و نساء قاتلوا للدفاع عن وطنهم.

paragraph: Her speech moved the **audience**. Many people in the **audience** didn't understand the joke. The **audience** was carried away by his touching performance.
english: group of people seeing a performance
arabicDesc: مثال: خطابها أثَر في الجمهور.

paragraph: I lost my **shoe** in the fire. What size **shoe** do you wear? Do you have these **shoes** in my size?
english: protective covering for the foot
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد فقدت حذائي في الحريق.

paragraph: German and Japanese government bonds offer **negative** interest rates. Why is your first reaction to anything always **negative**? It can be very difficult to prove a **negative**.
english: not positive or neutral; bad; undesirable; unfavourable

paragraph: Do you know that **fellow**? I absolutely will not speak to that **fellow** again! Who in the world is the **fellow** over there?
english: a person in the same situation; also a man
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تعرف ذاك الشخص؟

paragraph: If you lay a **finger** on me, I'll break your arm. Never point your **finger** at me. I have cut my **finger**.
english: (anatomy) extremity of the hand
arabicDesc: مثال: إن لمستني بأصبعك فقط، فسأكسر ذراعك.

paragraph: It was that same **van** again. The **van** was driving extremely slowly. The **van** was painted green.
english: an enclosed railway vehicle for transport of goods, such as a boxcar/box van
arabicDesc: مثال: كانت تلك نفس العربة من جديد.

other.meaning: A city, the capital of Van Province, Turkey, on the shore of the lake (noun)

paragraph: Can I take some of the **samples**? This is a free **sample**. It doesn't cost anything. They sent me a **sample** in answer to my request.
english: statistics
arabicDesc: مثال: هل يمكنني أن آخذ بعض العينات؟

paragraph: I like to **download** books. How do you **download** a photo from this site? Did you **download** the latest software for your computer?
english: a file transfer to a given computer or device from a remote one through a network connection
arabicDesc: مثال: أحب تحميل الكتب.

other.meaning: To transfer data to a given computer from a remote one via a network (verb)

paragraph: He was far in **advance** of his days. You would do well to tell it to him in **advance**. Thank you in **advance** for your help.
english: to promote or advantage
arabicDesc: مثال: كان رجلاً سابقاً لعصره.

paragraph: Everyone is free to **contribute**. Do you want to **contribute** something to the program? Another way is to go to the **contribute** page.
english: to give something, that is or becomes part of a larger whole
arabicDesc: مثال: يمكن للجميع أن يشارك.

paragraph: Don't forget to **mail** this letter. I remember **mailing** the letter. You can get in touch with me by **mail**.
english: postal delivery system
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تنسى أن تبعت هذه الرسالة.

other.meaning: To send (a letter, parcel, etc.) through the mail (verb)

paragraph: **Ignore** what he said. He was only joking. The teacher was **ignoring** me. This problem can't be **ignored**.
english: to deliberately pay no attention to
arabicDesc: مثال: تجاهل ما قاله. مقد كان يمزح فقط.

paragraph: They represent not only themselves but this **institution** as well. The library is a public **institution** for everyone. The **institution** of marriage appears to be on the decline.
english: established organisation

paragraph: I am the one who invited you to **dinner**. I want my **dinner** brought to my room. He was so mad that he forgot to eat **dinner**.
english: evening meal
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا من دعوتك للعشاء.

paragraph: It was such a **shock**. What he said then **shocked** me. What you're about to learn just might **shock** you.
english: sudden, heavy impact
arabicDesc: مثال: يا لها من صدمة.

other.meaning: To cause to be emotionally shocked (verb)

paragraph: Some women should never give **birth**. What is your date of **birth**? She gave **birth** to a son.
english: to give birth (to)
arabicDesc: مثال: بعض النّساء لا ينبغي أن يلدن أبدا.

paragraph: Did you **hunt** in the hills this morning? Cats learn how to **hunt** from their mothers. **Hunt** me down if you don't hear anything.
english: to find or search for an animal in the wild with the intention of killing the animal for its meat or for sport
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: صاد

paragraph: I'm sorry I didn't **reply** to you sooner. Sorry I didn't **reply** to your message earlier, I was busy. I hope this letter interests you and look forward to your **reply**.
english: to give a written or spoken response
arabicDesc: مثال: أعتذر لعدم الرد عليك أبكر.

paragraph: Most people here are not interested in your **religion**. I have my own opinions concerning politics and **religion**. I studied your **religion**, but I didn't like it.
english: system of beliefs dealing with soul, deity and/or life after death

paragraph: **Apparently**, the bus is late. **Apparently**, nothing new has been added to the list. I thought that was true, but **apparently** it wasn't.
english: seemingly
arabicDesc: مثال: يبدو أن الحافلة تأخرت عن الوصول.

paragraph: Will I be able to see you next **Monday**? You must have the report done by **Monday**. My favourite day of the week is **Monday**.
english: the day of the week after Sunday
arabicDesc: مثال: هل بإمكاني مقابلتك يوم الإثنين؟

paragraph: Your teacher has **obviously** no manners. She was **obviously** in pain. **Obviously**, he is to blame.
english: in an obvious or clearly apparent manner
arabicDesc: مثال: من الواضح أنّ مدرّسك ليس لديه أخلاق.

paragraph: This week, we welcome the president of the **senate**. You were elected to the **Senate** in 2008, weren't you? He was elected to the **Senate** in the last election.
english: in some bicameral legislative systems, the upper house or chamber

other.meaning: Any of several legislative bodies. (In countries which have multiple legislative bodies, the Senate is often the more senior.) (noun)

paragraph: **Somebody** has been eating in the meeting room. I have to talk to **somebody**. Is **somebody** in the house?
english: some unspecified person
arabicDesc: مثال: كان أحدهم يأكل في قاعة الاجتماع.

paragraph: No one can **deny** the fact. No one could **deny** this. Now you won't be able to **deny** what happened.
english: to assert that something is not true
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يستطيع أحد أن ينكر هذا.

paragraph: I just had a meeting with the new **client**. The lawyer recommended that his **client** take legal action. He should work on one **client** at a time.
english: a customer, a buyer or receiver of goods or services
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مشتر

other.meaning: person who receives help or advice from a professional person

paragraph: Let's turn off the **television**. Where do you watch **television**? He didn't watch **television** yesterday.
english: an electronic communication medium that allows the transmission of real-time visual images, and often sound
arabicDesc: مثال: فلنغلق التلفاز .

paragraph: It looked like something back was running through the **forest**. The **forest** was, for some strange reason, quiet. Something was ripping its way through the **forest**.
english: dense collection of trees
arabicDesc: مثال: بدا و كأن شيئا أسود كان يجري في الغابة.

paragraph: I'm **surrounded** by people I don't like. Special forces **surrounded** the building. He always prefers to **surround** himself with girls.
english: to encircle something or simultaneously extend in all directions
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا محاط بأشخاص لا يعجبونني.

paragraph: Don't stick your nose where it doesn't **belong**. Does this cap **belong** to you? I **belong** to the drama club.
english: to have its proper place
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تحشر أنفك في ما لا يعنيك.

paragraph: This is the only **alternative**. Ageing isn't good, but the **alternative** is no better. Don't include multiple **alternative** words inside the same sentence.
english: another possible choice
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا هو الخيار الوحيد.

paragraph: You can take any train you like from **platform** 5. Please step back from the edge of the **platform**. There was only one other person on the **platform**.
english: a raised stage from which speeches are made and on which musical and other performances are made

paragraph: Every morning, I take the same **route** to work. They studied the map to find a shorter **route**. Excuse me, what's the shortest **route** to the station?
english: a course or way which is traveled or passed
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مسار

paragraph: How many gifts do you think she received last **holiday** season? Next Thursday is a **holiday**. When do you get up in the **holidays**?
english: day declared free from work by the government
arabicDesc: مثال: كم هديةً تتوقع أنها استلمت في الإجازة الماضية؟

other.meaning: period of one or more days taken off work for leisure and often travel

paragraph: His attempt ended in **failure**. You should acknowledge your **failure**. These are the steps that lead straight to **failure**.
english: state or condition opposite of success
arabicDesc: مثال: محاولته باءت بالفشل.

other.meaning: termination of the ability of an item to perform its required function

paragraph: Stay away from **conflict** at the office. What do you think is the best way to settle this **conflict**? He seems not to be aware of the **conflict** between my father and me.
english: clash or disagreement
arabicDesc: مثال: ابتعد عن الصراعات في المكتب.

paragraph: Is the cat on the **chair** or under the **chair**? Take this **chair** to the meeting room. Can you give that **chair** to her?
english: an item of furniture used to sit on or in, comprising a seat, legs or wheels, back, and sometimes arm rests, for use by one person
arabicDesc: مثال: هل القطة فوق الكرسي أم تحته؟

paragraph: A **giant** monster rose up from inside the hole. The **giant** dragon took the stars from the sky. Great! Now we can have one **giant** global police state.
english: a mythical human or humanoid of very great size

paragraph: They began to **manufacture** the machine on a large scale. Also, if you **manufacture** any other products, please send information. You'll have to **manufacture** some kind of excuse.
english: to make things, usually on a large scale, with tools and either physical labor or machinery
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: أنتج

paragraph: That subject won't be open to **debate** with you. I think that puts an end to the **debate**. Want to watch the student loan **debate** live stream?
english: an informal and spirited but generally civil discussion of opposing views
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مناقشة

paragraph: We finally found a man who fits this **description**. Give me a **description** of the scene you saw. He gave a minute **description** of the dinner party.
english: a sketch or account of anything in words
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: توصيف، تصوير، تفصيل

paragraph: You enter, with the key word being a **requirement**. Could you tell me what your specific **requirements** are? He tried to meet the **requirements** of his parents.
english: a necessity or prerequisite

paragraph: I learned a new **technique**. I wonder what the advantage of this **technique** is. This **technique** will cost you a lot less money.
english: practical aspects of a given art
arabicDesc: مثال: تعلمت تقنية جديدة.

paragraph: The **path** will take you to another field. You have to choose your own **path** in life. I went on the **path** down to the river.
english: a trail for the use of, or worn by, pedestrians
arabicDesc: مثال: سيقودك هذا الطريق إلى حقل آخر.

other.meaning: a method or direction of proceeding

paragraph: Why do you **blame** me for what happened? I will not **blame** him for the accident. Children often **blame** themselves when their parents divorce.
english: state of having caused a bad event
arabicDesc: مثال: لماذا تلومني على ما حصل؟

other.meaning: To assert or consider that someone is the cause of something negative (verb)

paragraph: It takes me three hours to **edit** it. The radio **edit** of the song is better than its original. How often do you **edit** your profile?
english: a change to the text of a document

other.meaning: To change a text, or a document (verb)

paragraph: Our dog was run over by a **truck**. He has to get off the **truck**. A **truck** was coming the other way.
english: heavier motor vehicle designed to carry goods — see also semi-trailer truck, pickup truck
arabicDesc: مثال: دهست شاحنة كلبنا.

paragraph: There are tons of boys who would love to **kiss** me. I would like to **kiss** you. She **kissed** him in front of everyone.
english: to touch with the lips
arabicDesc: مثال: هناك الكثير من الفتيان الذين يودون تقبيلي.

other.meaning: A touch with the lips, usually to express love or affection, or as a greeting (noun)

paragraph: **Christ** on a bike, my in-laws are here. I am not the **Christ** but I am sent ahead of him. We should live our lives as though **Christ** were coming this afternoon.
english: the anointed one, the savior predicted by the Old Testament

paragraph: It's too **dangerous** for you to stay here. It must be **dangerous** to play there. It is **dangerous** to drive so fast.
english: full of danger
arabicDesc: مثال: خطير جداً لكِ أن تكوني هنا.

paragraph: This is an **extremely** important point. The water is **extremely** cold. The sky was **extremely** clean.
english: very much
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه نقطة مهمة جداً.

paragraph: A friend in need is a friend **indeed**. It may, **indeed**, be a mistake. True love is **indeed** rare, but it's the only thing that gives life meaning.
english: really; used to agree or add something stronger
arabicDesc: مثال: الصديق وقت الضيق

paragraph: You never realize the value of something **till** you lose it. Don't move **till** I get back. Wait **till** the rain stops.
english: until
arabicDesc: مثال: لن تعرف قيمة الشيء حتى تفقده.

other.meaning: To develop so as to improve or prepare for usage (verb)

paragraph: We are going to **cycle** to the lake tomorrow. Do you walk to school, or do you **cycle**? I do not have a car, just a **cycle**.
english: an interval of space or time in which one set of events or phenomena is completed
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: دورة

paragraph: When did you **graduate** from college? Next spring I want to **graduate**. At last, I **graduated** from junior high school.
english: to be recognized by a university as having completed the requirements of a degree
arabicDesc: مثال: متى تخرّجت من الكليّة؟

paragraph: The man we held so **dear** has passed away. What do you think about it, my **dear** friends? Oh **dear**, you don't look too happy. What's wrong?
english: high in price
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: عزيزة

other.meaning: an informal way of addressing the recipient in a letter's opening line
precious to or greatly valued by someone

paragraph: Can you give me a **lift** to the station? It's too heavy. I can't **lift** it. He offered to give her a **lift** to the bus station.
english: to raise or rise
arabicDesc: مثال: هل لك أن تقلني إلى المحطة؟

other.meaning: An act of lifting or raising (noun)

paragraph: We had that teacher for fourth and **fifth** grade. And the evening and morning were the **fifth** day. Do they live on the fourth or **fifth** floor?
english: ordinal form of the number 5 — see also 5th
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: خامسة

other.meaning: The person or thing in the fifth position (noun)

paragraph: What means of **transport** did you use to get here? What means of **transport** do you use most often? The packages must have been damaged during the **transport**.
english: to carry or bear from one place to another
arabicDesc: مثال: بأي وسيلة مواصلات أتيت إلى هنا؟

paragraph: I can't tell the difference between these two **wines**. What are some of your favorite French **wines**? The store has a large stock of **wines**.
english: an alcoholic beverage made by fermenting grape juice, with an ABV ranging from 5.5–16%
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: خمر، شراب، نبيت

paragraph: It was not long before they made their **appearance**. How do I feel about my **appearance** right now? It's not just performance that's important, but also **appearance**.
english: a thing seen

other.meaning: the act of appearing or coming into sight

paragraph: Don't fill up your **bowl** with too much food. I saw a set of keys in the **bowl**. There isn't much sugar left in the sugar **bowl**.
english: a roughly hemispherical container used to hold, mix, prepare or present food, such as salad, fruit or soup, or other items
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: سلطانية

paragraph: A real friend is like a **rare** bird. For most of them, this is quite a **rare** experience. How did you come by these **rare** books?
english: very uncommon
arabicDesc: مثال: الصديق الوفي كالطائر النادر.

paragraph: I'm **proud** to have him as a friend. There is nothing to be **proud** of. She was very **proud** of her father.
english: gratified, feeling honoured, feeling satisfied
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا فخور بكونه صديقي.

paragraph: No one survived the plane **crash**. The plane **crashed** into the house. The car **crashed** into the truck.
english: 11. (computing, hardware, software, intransitive) To terminate or halt execution.
arabicDesc: مثال: لم ينجُ أحد من تحطم الطائرة.

paragraph: Fashion is one of the engines of **consumer** society. This company focuses on fast moving **consumer** goods. The **consumer** prices index rose 2% this year.
english: one who, or that which, consumes
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مستنفد

paragraph: I would like to speak to the head **nurse**. The doctor was talking to the **nurse**. Her dream is to become a **nurse**.
english: person trained to provide care for the sick
arabicDesc: مثال: أود التحدث إلى رئيس الممرضين.

other.meaning: To breastfeed: to feed (a baby) at the breast (verb)

paragraph: Do you ever dream about flying through the **sky**? The houses and cars looked tiny from the **sky**. The sea was calm and the **sky** was clear.
english: with a descriptive word: the part of the sky which can be seen from a specific place or at a specific time
arabicDesc: مثال: هل سبق لك أن حلمت بالطيران في السماء؟

other.meaning: the abode of God or the gods, etc. — see also heaven

paragraph: My mother sent me a **birthday** present. Only if you come will she come to my **birthday** party. He couldn't think what he should give her for her **birthday**.
english: anniversary
arabicDesc: مثال: أرسلت لي أمي هدية لعيد ميلادي.

paragraph: My parents don't **approve** of my girlfriend. Could you **approve** my proposal? All of us **approved** of the plan.
english: to officially sanction
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يوافق والديَّ على حبيبتي.

other.meaning: to regard as good; to commend; to be pleased with; to think well of

paragraph: How many times do I need to **repeat** it? I will **repeat** so that you will not forget it. Could you please **repeat** what you just said?
english: do or say again
arabicDesc: مثال: كم مرّة عليّ تكرار ذلك؟

paragraph: The secret to **victory** is to not give up. It's a nice **victory**, but it's not over yet. **Victory** is so close, I can almost taste it.
english: the condition or state of having won a battle or competition, or having succeeded in an effort
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: نصر

paragraph: Which do you like better, blues or **classic** rock? I will get that **classic** car at all costs. Her dress was **classic** black, perfect for any occasion.
english: of high quality and lasting value; typical

paragraph: The dispute was finally **settled**. They were among the first people to **settle** here. What part of the country did they **settle** in?
english: to conclude or resolve (something):
arabicDesc: مثال: في النهاية حل الخلاف.

paragraph: Which came first, the chicken or the **egg**? The world is an **egg**. How many **eggs** do you eat per day?
english: synonym of ovum (“the female gamete of an animal”)
arabicDesc: مثال: أيهما جاء أولاً، الدجاجة أم البيضة؟

other.meaning: edible egg of a domestic fowl; the contents of such an egg or eggs used as food

paragraph: We have been **apart** for many months. It's hard to tell you **apart** from your brother. **Apart** from her name, I know nothing about her.
english: separated by distance or time
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد افترقنا لعدّة أشهر.

paragraph: Is he **aware** of the difficulty? I'm **aware** of your problem. I wasn't **aware** that you were feeling so bad.
english: knowing that something exists or is happening
arabicDesc: مثال: هل هو على علم بالصعوبة؟

paragraph: We moved to the **Eastern** side of the country. He's a Western guy and she's an **Eastern** girl. He lived in **Eastern** Europe for a while.
english: of, facing, situated in, or related to the east

paragraph: She warmed **herself** by the fire. That old woman lives by **herself**. She cooked **herself** a good meal.
english: (as intensifier) she
arabicDesc: مثال: تدفأت علي النار .

paragraph: It is **impossible** for me to forget you. That would make it **impossible** for him to save face. French people don't think of anything as **impossible**.
english: not able to be done
arabicDesc: مثال: من المستحيل أن انساك

paragraph: He can speak neither English **nor** French. He's neither for **nor** against the proposal. It is neither good **nor** bad.
english: and... not (introducing a negative statement, without necessarily following one)
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يستطيع أن يتكلم الإنجلزية و الفرنسية.

paragraph: Police were **pounding** on the door. He was **pounding** her gate. I felt my heart **pound** after running a little.
english: unit of mass (16 ounces avoirdupois)
arabicDesc: مثال: كانت الشّرطة تدقّ الباب بقوّة.

paragraph: When I hear that song I remember my **youth**. In her **youth**, my mother was very beautiful. We must take his **youth** into account.
english: quality or state of being young
arabicDesc: مثال: عندما أسمع هذه الأغنية أتذكر شبابي.

paragraph: I've phoned him to **remind** him about it. If you don't **remind** me, I'll forget. Always **remind** yourself of who you are.
english: cause one to experience a memory; bring to a person's notice
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد اتّصلت به لتفكيره بهذا الأمر.

paragraph: There is a scheme to **expand** the company. Our company wants to **expand** into a new market. Developing countries are looking to **expand** their labor markets.
english: to change (something) from a smaller form or size to a larger one
arabicDesc: مثال: هناك مخطط لتوسيع الشركة.

other.meaning: (transitive) to increase the extent, number, volume or scope of
(intransitive) to increase in extent, number, volume or scope

paragraph: I made him **paint** the house. Do you know who bought your **painting**? The door will be **painted** tomorrow.
english: to apply paint to
arabicDesc: مثال: جعلته يدهن البيت.

paragraph: If you pull too hard, the **chain** will break. A link can join two pieces of **chain** together. I reached out because he runs a hotel **chain**.
english: a series of interconnected rings or links usually made of metal

paragraph: These are two pictures with a nice **frame**. The most important thing in art is the **frame**. From what material is the **frame** of your glasses?
english: to fit, as for a specific end or purpose
arabicDesc: مثال: هاتان صورتان جميلتان إطاراهُما.

other.meaning: cause a person to appear guilty
The structural elements of a building or other constructed object (noun)

paragraph: I hope that people will come to our **festival**. She made friends with them at the school **festival**. Have you ever been to a music **festival** before?
english: event or community gathering
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: عيد
